notes.title: Saint Ceri is now released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Saint Ceri is now released! It'll be on sale until next week.
If you buy and enjoy Saint Ceri, please consider leaving a review! Reviews are super important for games to be visible on steam.
Do let me know if you encounter any bugs! All endings should be unlockable, but if any lines seem weird (like referencing the wrong romance, or a choice you didn't make), please use the bug report form that's in the game's main menu! I'll try to get fixes out pretty quickly.

Thank you for your support!
